verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot, its own AI agent, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can act as an MCP client, and the axis applies. The pack documents only Slack's official MCP server, which exposes Slack tools to outside MCP clients, plus app-directory integrations and request routing to agents. Those are the server role and adjacent features, and nothing shows Slack or Slackbot connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.
